## Usage by Role

### For Developers
1. **First time?** Read [QUICK-REFERENCE.md](QUICK-REFERENCE.md)
2. **Writing code?** Let GitHub Copilot use [copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md)
3. **Have questions?** Check the FAQ in [QUICK-REFERENCE.md](QUICK-REFERENCE.md)
4. **Want to help?** Read [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

### For Team Leads
1. **Understanding the setup?** See [IMPLEMENTATION-SUMMARY.md](IMPLEMENTATION-SUMMARY.md)
2. **Adopting for your team?** Review [AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md](AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md)
3. **Setting up a new project?** Copy [copilot-instructions.template.md](copilot-instructions.template.md)
4. **Maintaining context?** Follow [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

### For Project Managers
1. **What was delivered?** Read [IMPLEMENTATION-SUMMARY.md](IMPLEMENTATION-SUMMARY.md)
2. **What are the benefits?** See the README.md benefits section
3. **How to measure success?** Check "Measuring Effectiveness" in [AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md](AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md)

### For New Contributors
1. **Getting started?** Begin with [../README.md](../README.md)
2. **Understanding context?** Read [AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md](AI-AGENT-CONTEXT-SPEC.md)
3. **Want to contribute?** See [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
